authorization.scope: Unattended evaluation of a four-routing-layer six-layer construction, with an eight-layer four-routing-layer alternative if needed.
authorization.objective: Reduce overall engineering time and agent-token cost; bare-board cost is secondary.
authorization.old_output_checker: Its exhausted allowance remains stopped; this is an independent input-profile task.

sources.finding: Fifteen named six-layer constructions are listed; old JLC06161H-3313 is not the only option.
Exact current template identifies core-specific Dk values and finished 1.65mm +/-10%; use these rather than the generic core Dk4.6 table.
Actual JLC08161H-3313 construction, not an extrapolation from six layers.

dielectric_gaps.material: bare FR4 core without copper faces

six_primary.rationale: One additional routing layer versus four-layer S/G/S/S, with a close ground reference for every signal layer. The central signal pair is separated by more than eleven times its respective 0.1mm ground distance.
six_primary.representation_gate: Preserve separate central prepreg/core/prepreg material thicknesses and Dk. KiCad 10 supports bare addsublayer tokens; its container type is shared. No silent homogeneous averaging. Native roundtrip and Quilter import remain to be demonstrated.
six_primary.mechanical_limit: Nominal 1.6mm selection is not exact 1.6mm construction. This is an isolated study; final thickness/tolerance, service fit and contact/mount stack need mechanical rebinding before manufacture.

eight_fallback.rationale: Same four routing layers and close references, with additional ground shielding between the internal signals. Not two more routing layers than the six-primary option.
activation_conditions: Six-primary composite dielectric cannot be represented faithfully by native/imported tools.
Six-primary returned routing demonstrates a material reference/plane limitation, rather than assuming all collision reports are solved by layer count.
eight_fallback.status: Actual supplier alternative identified; no native input or cloud draft constructed.

reference_design_disposition.benefit: Mature Adafruit reference designs reduce circuit and component-selection risk.
